class.name: GodotDoctorSummaryReport
class.brief_description: Aggregates results from all validation suite reports into a single top-level summary.

method.name: _init
method.description: Creates a new [GodotDoctorSummaryReport] from the given [param suite_reports].

method.name: get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level messages across all suites. Prefer accessing this via [method get_stats] with [constant Stat.INFO_COUNT] to avoid unnecessary recomputation.

method.name: get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level messages across all suites. Prefer accessing this via [method get_stats] with [constant Stat.WARNING_COUNT] to avoid unnecessary recomputation.

method.name: get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level messages across all suites. Prefer accessing this via [method get_stats] with [constant Stat.HARD_ERROR_COUNT] to avoid unnecessary recomputation.

method.name: _get_num_suites
method.description: Returns the total number of validation suites in this summary.

method.name: _get_num_scenes
method.description: Returns the total number of scenes validated across all suites.

method.name: _get_num_nodes
method.description: Returns the total number of nodes validated across all suites.

method.name: _get_num_resources
method.description: Returns the total number of resources validated across all suites.

method.name: _get_num_warnings_as_errors
method.description: Returns the total number of warnings that were treated as errors across all suites.

method.name: _get_num_effective_errors
method.description: Returns the total number of effective errors (hard errors plus warnings promoted by [member GodotDoctorValidationSuite.treat_warnings_as_errors]).

method.name: _passed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if validation passed (no effective errors), or [code]false[/code] if validation failed (one or more effective errors).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns a dictionary of aggregate summary stats keyed by [enum Stat]. These stats are intended to be used for high-level reporting of validation results and should be accessed through the [Dictionary] generated by this method to prevent unnecessary recomputation of these values.

method.name: get_suite_reports
method.description: Returns all validation suite reports in this summary.

members.member: The list of validation suite reports that make up this summary.
